testing_evidence.evidence: Production-seam unit tests cover arrival/response ordering, duplicate/mismatch/terminal correlation, first-claim ownership, simultaneous conflict, and error mapping. Real TCP/TLS DV pauses after DataConnReady registration and executes caller-abort guard drop, tunnel-close cleanup, new-requester timeout against an old creator, and command-12 rejection by an old requester; snapshots verify waiter, staged entry, and data connection counts return to zero. DV also covers fallback/reuse and terminal errors. One composed signed x509 A-to-PN-to-B test proves ProxyOpenResp Success plus bidirectional bytes through PN/TTP and real reverse TCP.
